create.approverHint: Choose one or more of the client’s users. Whoever you choose can decide this request and gets access to the project. The first decision settles it.
create.drafted: {{ref}} saved as a draft. The client cannot see it yet.
create.existingHint: Only Client Visible files, milestones and tasks can be linked. The exact file version is recorded.
create.failed: The approval request could not be saved.
create.freeformDescription: Describe what the client is approving (optional)
create.freeformHint: A free-form item has no record behind it. The name and description you write here are exactly what the client sees and approves.
create.freeformName: Item name, e.g. Launch rollout approach
create.hiddenHint: {{count}} item(s) in this project are Internal Only and cannot be linked. Share them with the client first.
create.hiddenHint_one: {{count}} item in this project is Internal Only and cannot be linked. Share it with the client first.
create.hiddenHint_other: {{count}} items in this project are Internal Only and cannot be linked. Share them with the client first.
create.itemPlaceholder: Select a file, milestone or task…
create.noApprovers: This client has no active users yet. Invite one under Clients → Users.
create.noLinkable: Nothing in this project is shared with the client yet.
create.noPortalProjects: No projects have the Client Portal turned on. Turn it on in Portal Projects first.

detail.cancelBody: {{ref}} is withdrawn and {{approver}} no longer sees it as pending. The history is kept.
detail.cancelFailed: The approval could not be cancelled.
detail.cancelled: {{ref}} cancelled. It disappears from the client’s pending actions.
detail.linkFreeform: Free-form item · not linked to a record
detail.newerVersion: This approval covers v{{approved}}. The file has since moved to v{{current}}. The approval still points at v{{approved}}; request a new revision to cover the newer version.
detail.resubmitFailed: The approval could not be resubmitted.
detail.resubmitted: {{ref}} is awaiting approval again as revision {{revision}}. {{approver}} is notified. The previous decision is preserved.
detail.reviseHint: The current description is kept as revision {{revision}}. {{approver}} is notified by email and in the portal.
detail.sendFailed: The approval could not be sent.

edit.approverHint: Anyone you add is notified and gets access to the project. The first decision settles the request.
edit.failed: The request could not be updated.
edit.linkedLocked: The linked item cannot be changed. Cancel this request and create a new one to approve something else.
edit.title: Edit {{ref}}

columnHelp.approval: What the client is asked to approve.
columnHelp.approver: The client user who must approve.
columnHelp.client: The client organization asked to approve.
columnHelp.due: The date the decision is due. Overdue dates show in red.
columnHelp.id: Unique reference of the approval request.
columnHelp.linked: The file, milestone or task the approval covers, with its version.
columnHelp.project: The project this approval belongs to.
columnHelp.requested: The date the approval was requested.
columnHelp.status: Where the approval stands: draft, awaiting, approved or changes requested.
columnHelp.type: Whether it covers a file, milestone, task or free-form item.

list.deleteFailed: The approval could not be deleted.
list.description: Ask a client to approve a file, milestone, task or free-form item. The exact version or revision is recorded and every decision is kept.
list.empty: No approvals yet. Create one to ask a client for sign-off.
list.search: Search by ID, title, client, project, linked item, approver…
